description: Ranked failure modes of the dev blend, by physical cause of the move in the posted-offer median. Each entry stands alone.

modes.name: Provider enters or leaves the panel (composition)
modes.definition: The median moves because one provider's offer(s) appear or disappear near the middle of a 3-17 offer panel, with no surviving offer repriced.
modes.reverts: Weakly. Exited offers came back within 7 days in 5.6% of 162 fastgpu exits and 0% of 118 gpurentalprices exits. Regressing the next change on the jump: slope -0.01 (h=1), -0.24 [90% CI -0.27,-0.04] (h=3), -0.16 [-0.30,-0.14] (h=7), n=56-60; only 5% of jumps fully undo within 7 days.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Size yes, timing no. The jump equals the one-offer 'fragility' of the origin panel (largest median change from dropping one offer): correlation 0.88, median ratio 1.00, n=60. The new value is an origin order statistic or midpoint (k=1) in 79% of h=1 and 54% of h=7 composition moves. Timing is not foreseeable from fragility: median fragility on composition days 0.047 vs 0.074 on all days. Events cluster: 60 events on 19 dates; one provider changes its listings across 4-7 series on one day (modal 2026-10-02 and 10-04, daytona 2026-09-29, quantacloud 2026-10-06, nebius 2026-10-05).
dated_examples: 2026-10-02->2026-10-03 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.A100_40GB.on_demand.median: median 1.294->1.990 (+0.430 log), pivotal provider lambdalabs,verda; entered: lambdalabs; exited: lambdalabs; repriced up: verda; offers 3->7
2026-10-01->2026-10-02 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.A100_40GB.on_demand.median: median 1.642->1.294 (-0.238 log), pivotal provider modal; exited: modal; offers 4->3
modes.notes: Kinds (one-day, n=60): entry 35, exit 20, sku relabel 5 (same provider exits and re-enters under new sku_raw; 0.82 of 2.83 total abs log change from composition). 10% of one-day changes but 28% of their abs log change. Misses split evenly by side (40% of cells above q90; 14.6% of total blend loss from below-q10 composition misses). Largest single series: gpurentalprices A100_40GB, 2026-10-03, lambdalabs listings 1->5 offers, median 1.294->1.990, 5.2% of all blend loss.
modes.scope: Scope: 37 rental_headline series, dev blend cells (origins 2026-08-18..2026-10-06, h=1,3,7, n=4266 with panel), one-day events 2026-08-04..2026-10-13 (n=579). Blend = mix+gbm+chronos_last, runs/failure/blend_dev_cells.parquet. Cause of an h-day move: counterfactual median of origin-day offers at target-day prices (repricing) vs the rest (composition); label needs >=80% of |effect| in one part, else mixed. Offer key: fastgpu provider; gpurentalprices provider+sku_raw; afhubbard provider+region+sku+gpu_count.

modes.name: Repricing and entry/exit in the same window (mixed)
modes.definition: Within the horizon both a surviving offer is repriced and offers enter or leave, each carrying >20% of the median's move; mostly B200/B300 rate cards in the late-September/early-October repricing wave.
modes.reverts: No evidence of reversion (one-day mixed events n=23, slope +0.30 [0.03,0.38] at h=1; h=7 interval [-0.45,1.74], n=18).
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Partly: the repricing part is the Verda/Nebius/fal upward wave already under way at the origin; the entry/exit part (modal exit 2026-10-02, together entry) is not.
dated_examples: 2026-10-01->2026-10-02 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand.median: median 7.625->8.708 (+0.133 log), pivotal provider nebius,modal; exited: modal; repriced up: fal,nebius,verda; offers 8->7
2026-10-01->2026-10-02 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B200.on_demand.median: median 6.470->6.985 (+0.077 log), pivotal provider fal,modal; exited: modal; repriced up: fal,nebius,verda; offers 10->9
modes.notes: 54% of mixed cells have truth above q90. Worst cells: fastgpu B300 origin 2026-09-30/10-01, last value 7.625, truth 9.06-9.15 against q90 7.79-7.92 (nebius, fal, verda up; modal out; together in). Small n; one episode dominates.

modes.name: Verda small upward reprices accumulating (repricing)
modes.definition: Provider verda raises a posted rate by about 1% (median one-day move of the median 0.5%), many days in a row, on up to 17 fastgpu and 10 gpurentalprices series; when verda is the median or adjacent, the median climbs in small steps.
modes.reverts: No. Verda reprices return to the previous price within 7 days 1.1% (fastgpu, n=352) and 0.5% (gpurentalprices, n=219); 96.8% of median-moving verda events are up. fastgpu repricing events show momentum: slope +0.18 [0.02,0.30] at h=1, +0.40 [0.19,0.77] at h=3 (n=134, 124).
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Yes. 97.6% of the 247 median-moving verda events were preceded by another verda reprice in the same collector within 7 days; verda repriced something on 75% of fastgpu days and 35% of gpurentalprices days.
dated_examples: 2026-09-12..09-14 origins, fastgpu B300 rate card: last value 7.50-7.575, all blend quantiles at the last value, truth 7.85 at h=7 after verda reprices up (loss 0.175 per cell).
2026-09-13->2026-09-14 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.A100_40GB.on_demand.median: median 1.290->1.251 (-0.031 log), pivotal provider verda; repriced down: verda; offers 3->3
modes.notes: Verda does 84% of fastgpu reprices on 13.8% of its offer-days and 39% of gpurentalprices reprices on 12.4%. Loss is mostly h=7 (0.110 of 0.175). The blend often has zero width here (q10=q50=q90=last value).

modes.name: sfcompute marketplace ask swings (repricing)
modes.definition: On gpurentalprices H100_80GB marketplace_ask (3 offers), the sfcompute ask is the median and moves by a median 5.6% per change; together with spheron it produces the largest one-day swings.
modes.reverts: Partly. gpurentalprices repricing events revert: slope -0.33 [-0.58,-0.01] at h=1 and -0.46 [-0.69,-0.19] at h=7 (n=292, 256). spheron's reprices return to the previous price within 7 days 66% of the time (n=41); sfcompute's 6% (n=48).
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Volatility yes (sfcompute repriced on 48 of ~70 days), direction no.
dated_examples: 2026-08-12->2026-08-13 gpurentalprices.marketplace_ask.H100_80GB.spot.median: median 1.970->1.200 (-0.496 log), pivotal provider sfcompute; repriced down: sfcompute; offers 3->3
2026-09-01->2026-09-02 gpurentalprices.marketplace_ask.H100_80GB.spot.median: median 1.686->1.231 (-0.315 log), pivotal provider sfcompute; repriced up: spheron; repriced down: sfcompute; offers 3->3
modes.notes: One series; 32% of one-day abs log change in the set but 8.9% of blend loss, because the blend is already wide here (blend/last-value loss 0.63; only 12% of cells above q90).

modes.name: Hyperscaler spot repricing (gcp, aws)
modes.definition: Spot prices of surviving hyperscaler offers change (afhubbard ~450 offers per series-day, fastgpu 3 offers); gcp and aws do 63% and 35% of afhubbard reprices.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Partly: afhubbard's new median is an origin order statistic in 67% of h=1 moves (n=42) because the panel is dense.
dated_examples: 2026-09-29->2026-09-30 fastgpu_daily.hyperscaler_spot.T4.spot.median: median 0.075->0.088 (+0.160 log), pivotal provider aws; repriced up: aws; offers 3->3
2026-09-21->2026-09-22 fastgpu_daily.hyperscaler_spot.T4.spot.median: median 0.087->0.080 (-0.084 log), pivotal provider aws; repriced down: aws; offers 3->3
modes.notes: Per-offer daily reprice chance 0.20 on afhubbard (n=124k offer-days), strongly clustered by provider and day (given one offer of a provider repriced that day, 89% of its others did too).

modes.definition: A surviving offer of a provider other than verda, sfcompute or scaleway is repriced and is pivotal for the median.
modes.reverts: Mixed: spheron 66% back within 7 days; nebius/fal moves in the October wave persist.

modes.name: Scaleway sub-percent drift
modes.definition: scaleway's posted USD rates move by a median 0.2% per change (230 reprices, 5 series), consistent with currency conversion; it moves the median when scaleway is the middle offer (L4, H100_80GB, B300 on gpurentalprices).
modes.reverts: No (2.2% back to previous price within 7 days).
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Yes, it is continuous small drift.
dated_examples: 2026-10-07->2026-10-08 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.L4.on_demand.median: median 0.887->0.880 (-0.008 log), pivotal provider scaleway; repriced down: scaleway; offers 3->3

modes.notes: 120 one-day events but only 1.6% of abs log change and 1.7% of blend loss. Not worth modelling.
